limits: Derived assembly binds unchanged originals and existing independent scoped decisions. It makes no new source, mechanics, visual, package or unit-acceptance decision; current accepted authority remains 16/213.

Study PNGs are original source-project captures, not app screenshots or a new exact-current release. Original study counters, source maps and capture-time authority remain unchanged; native live-attachment evidence is bound separately.

Native PNGs are 1440x900; full AVI originals and exact selected MJPEG payloads are 1280x800. Each movie retains its original 70 physical trailing bytes. Encoded, physics, process and drawn counters are distinct; sparse samples do not establish continuous playback or flicker freedom.

Routes use actual stock inputs and separate explicit setup poses; spray attempts invoke the stock API after grounded/camera/range checks. No continuous traversal between setups, physical mouse dispatch, manual-input, M1 or universal-runtime claim is supplied.

Reference photographs remain external and private. No reference pixels are copied into these packets, Git or an app. Cropped, occluded, hidden/rear and unsurveyed counts/dimensions remain unknown or production inference.

Candidate package verification and the separate seventh unit/image-tree attestation remain pending/null. A shared future app must verify each target attachment and predicates; neither one unit packet nor old source results certify another unit or a package.

1238 Northpoint captures retain their original 16/213 source world and corrected frozen geometry. Rejected readiness001 never ran. All 12 upper trims retain the accepted 76.499939mm fascia separation; no geometry changed during packet assembly.

March 2025 references support the stepped blue-gray public frontage, pale trim, broad paired windows, dark-blue doors and screens. Both footprint ends appear in the wide reference, while the right tree hides local roof/window/base details; the 1235 panorama label identifies camera context, not the target.

Original door raw ok:false and exit1 remain unchanged: the 150mm station predicate fails on rows161–210, with maximum actual orthogonal offset174.460835mm. The accepted narrower physical interpretation is grounded, camera-clear corridor traversal and effective door obstruction/natural stop, with minimum lateral capsule-edge margin135.539mm. This is not station-held PASS; the front terminus differs9.731µm at Float32 scale.

The original door run contains exactly210 rows (180 input+30 brake),57 qualifying door-contact events on57 rows and17 hardware-contact rows. Screen and all sprays were unperformed. Its motion-finalization.json selection_scope falsely claims four PNGs/screen/sprays; that inherited prose is rejected here while its original bytes and actual two PNGs remain retained.

The separately reviewed continuation contains95 rows (65 input+30 brake), with36 screen-contact events across31 unique rows35–65. Forward input removes normal approach but permits lateral sliding; after input release all30 brake rows stop. It proves neither total arrest while input remains held nor indefinite containment by the finite screen.

Continuation raw ok:true retains station_held:false at448.665976mm against the150mm diagnostic. The accepted scoped physical result uses actual screen obstruction/natural braking, not false centering. Independent orthogonal final depth1.679356m is distinct from raw nonorthogonal1.655336m.

Only the continuation performs the three sprays: mapped wall placement at5.161040m, door rejection at3.544172m and screen rejection at2.532521m; tag counts0→1,1→1,1→1. No skipped case counts as rejection. Its separate19.169342375s process includes a measured4.317812s spray phase and14.135ms total stock-call time; those are not preparation/review or avoided-runtime measurements.

Both full movies remain separate: original door297 frames and continuation315 frames. Each has nine retained exact samples; Original indices264/295 are byte-identical held door views; only continuation index313 is plain blue teardown, not scene evidence. No fictional single continuous all-success movie, changed-light replay or door retry is introduced.
